YouTube Notes

Create a note from a YouTube video in Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.

  1. Install and enable YouTube Notes in Obsidian.
  2. Drag the link below to your browser's bookmarks bar.
  3. Open a YouTube video, then click the saved bookmark. Allow the browser to open Obsidian.
YouTube Notes

The bookmarklet pauses playback, captures the current time when available, and creates a note with a media_link property. An existing saved position in Obsidian takes precedence when reopening a video.

Prefer Web Clipper? Import the YouTube Notes template. It saves page content and the URL, not the current playback time.

This is an updated fork of Media Notes, created by jemstelos. Credit for the original concept, plugin, and bookmarklet workflow belongs to them.
